results.assessment: Review candidates individually. Exact postal and normalized number/street line establish the same address/building only. Source point is for the GTP/facility address and can differ from tenant outlet position.

sources.name: Dementia Friendly Go-To-Points (GTPs)
sources.source_vintage: Data from Oct 2025; dataset last updated 2026-08-20, annual; feature FMEL_UPD_D 2026-08-18
sources.license: Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0; free for personal/commercial reuse with attribution
sources.attribution: Ministry of Health (MOH), Singapore, Dementia Friendly Go-To-Points dataset, accessed 2026-10-18
sources.match_method: Only workbook rows with missing coordinate pairs. Exact six-digit postal code equality, plus normalized source ADDRESS house number and street line appearing contiguously in normalized workbook Full Address. Source matching records must yield one unique coordinate.
sources.coordinate_semantics: Coordinates are GeoJSON points associated with GTP/facility address records, not verified F&B outlet or unit locations.

sources.name: Green Mark Buildings (GEOJSON)
sources.source_vintage: Source data from Apr 2022; last updated 2026-04-18
sources.license: Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0; free for personal/commercial reuse with attribution
sources.match_method: Exact six-digit postal plus normalized street number and name; street-number/name source fields blank for postal-overlap candidates, therefore no strict matches accepted.
sources.coordinate_semantics: Building Green Mark point; postal-only overlap cannot establish target address point.
